sources_note: Men's event fields with Official World Golf Ranking (OWGR) positions and Strokes Gained World Ratings: owgr.com official event pages (Week 43, 25 Oct 2026). Event/field confirmation for events without OWGR field tables via the tours' official pages and tournament notes (Asian Tour, LPGA, LET, PGA Tour Champions, Legends Tour, JGTO via GDO mirror, Sunshine Tour).
